the development of sunflower seeds is accompanied by a decrease in reactive oxygen species (ROS), nitric oxide, and superoxide dismutase (sod) activity and an increase in the activity of protein kinase C (PKc), glutathione reductase (GR), and peroxidase (POD).

the development of sunflower seed involves the modulation of ROS, their scavengers, calcium content, PKC activity, and their interrelationships.

the biochemical and molecular mechanisms of seed development in a model oil seed crop, sunflower.
the elucidation of the biochemical regulation of the process of sunflower seed development.
